prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original horizontal full-body group illustration of FOUR adult dwarves of the Iron Hills in their heavy battle armor for The One Ring culture art collection. Match the established recent horizontal group redraws: fine expressive warm muted brown pencil and pen contours, moderate selective directional hatching and limited crosshatching in recesses, small rich umber darks and broad pale ivory paper highlights. Traditional illustrated fantasy book drawing, not cinematic rendering.
Four distinct compact broad powerful dwarven soldiers stand together in a calm battle-ready formation, slightly staggered so every face and armor silhouette is readable. Short strong limbs, massive shoulders, thick necks, wide weathered faces, heavy brows, distinct noses and full beards in grouped braids. Left a younger sturdy warrior with open-faced angular helmet, one-handed axe held safely downward and a broad geometric shield; center-left an older commanding veteran with long divided beard, heavy angular helmet exposing face, both hands resting naturally on a grounded warhammer haft; center-right a broad middle-aged dwarf with a shorter braided beard, helmet with nose guard, a stout spear held upright and a shield at side; right a watchful seasoned warrior in a similar but distinct helmet, carrying a short heavy axe at rest and shield held close. No crowns. Faces visible and distinct, natural hands.
Armor is practical heavy dwarven forged plate over mail and quilted underlayers: broad overlapping shoulder plates, reinforced breastplates, heavy bracers, layered metal skirts, sturdy greaves and armored boots. Restrained angular geometric etched borders, rivets drawn economically, shields with simple angular bosses. Uniform shared craftsmanship with individual wear and small design differences. Clearly battle-equipped rather than travelling clothes. No oversized spikes, no fantasy glowing effects, no gore or battle action.
Approximately 16:10 landscape composition, four FULL figures spread comfortably across frame, all helmet tops, boots, shield edges, spear tip and weapons inside generous pale margins. Nearly white light ivory paper background, only faint sketch hatches behind group and small ground shadows beneath boots, no scenery. Metal modeled through clean outlines, pale planar highlights and selective hatch strokes under overlaps, not dense microtexture or photorealistic reflections. Beard in readable locks rather than individual hairs. No text, readable runes, page artifacts, border, watermark, full color, smooth blended photographic shading or thick cartoon outlines.
